Title: Azure SQL Database managed instance meter PITRs name changes

Body.Content:
Effective February 1, 2020, the meter names of Azure SQL Database managed instance point-in-time restore (PITR) backup will change.

There won't be a pricing impact from this change, but you'll need to modify billing routines that rely on names.

See the table below for the changes.
